name: Rainbow in Bloom Gemstone Necklace
materials: Gold-filled 14/20 Sailor Clasp can hold personalized charms; Gold-filled 14/20 accent beads, and components
description: Made with high-grade fluorite selected for its beautiful range of color, this necklace moves through soft green, honey, amethyst, violet, and blue. Gold hematite spacers add a warm glow, while quality gold-filled findings and a gold-filled front clasp give the piece a polished, elevated finish. A delicate floral dangle completes the design.
